title: Yara and the Language
author: Yara Okafor
blurb: Ansel Amberdale, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
